name: Abbie's World collectible card rubric
source_enum_note: source values are the identity schema's enum (docs/oracle/identity/game-identity.schema.json): footage_cv = computer vision over our own renders, llm_judge = VLM with saved prompt, pairwise and both orders, human = Evan, estimate = not yet measured.

geometry.rounding: round(mm / 25.4 * ppi) per dimension; canvas = trim + 2 x bleed

print.colour: PDF/X-4, CMYK, FOGRA39 or GRACoL 2013 coated
print.stock: 300 to 330 gsm black- or blue-core card, about 0.30 mm

tiers.label: Bloom
tiers.frame: lacquered wood, brass trim, spot-gloss name

tiers.label: Sun
tiers.frame: borderless or frame-break, full foil, parallax

gates.check: Canvas is 1630x2221 (600 ppi) or 814x1109 (300 ppi) with bleed, or the trim size for digital-only.
Every text, number and gem box lies inside the 3 mm safe rectangle and outside the 3 mm corner arcs.
At L0 print: body text >= 8 pt, name >= 10 pt, numerals >= 18 pt (font size from manifest; 1 pt = ppi/72 px).
Each text box: WCAG contrast >= 4.5 between text colour and the median plate colour; numerals >= 3.0 (outline counts as the text edge).
Art source pixel size >= art window size at 300 ppi; no upscaling ratio above 2x from the source.
No other game's art, frame, icon, font or text; provenance.json lists every image source and prompt; no source-game image used as a reference.
PG content; rules text Flesch-Kincaid grade <= 3; at most 15 words on the face.

checks.check: Downsample to 72 px tall (L2) and 160 px (L1). A VLM names cost, stat, rarity tier and card type. Score = correct / 4 at 72 px, averaged with the 160 px score.
Numeral cap height >= 6% of card height (so >= 4 px at 72 px).
Spectral-residual saliency mass inside the art window is at least its area share of the canvas (lift >= 1.0).
VLM lists what it sees first, second, third; full marks for art > name/cost > stats > text.
Art window is 50 to 65% of the face (standard) or 100% (Sun tier / full art).
Subject bbox centre within 10% of the art window's vertical axis.
Subject is 35 to 65% of art window height, focal point in upper half.
VLM names the subject from a black silhouette at 64 px.
Where text sits on a translucent plate over art, edge density of the art layer under it <= 0.6x the art window average. Opaque plates pass.
The card's declared art.mode passes that mode's checks in art_modes.
Passes at least 9 of the 12 art_direction checks.
OKLab deltaE between neighbouring tier gem colours >= 15 (x100 scale), also after deuteranopia and protanopia simulation.
Five gem silhouettes pairwise IoU <= 0.7.
Bloom and above carry at least one finish layer (gloss, foil or animation).
A VLM orders a shuffled five-tier lineup correctly.
Pairwise judge vs a flat-UI control card: 'which looks like a crafted physical object?' wins both orders.

Frame area (face minus the art window and the information plates: name, rules text, type banner and collector line; tokens and gem count as frame) is 15 to 35% of the face. Overlay and Sun cards are exempt.
Frame pixels span at least 3 distinct value bands (bevel highlight, body, shadow); luminance std >= 0.08.
At most two font families; open licence.
Numerals have an outline >= 8% of glyph height or sit on a solid token.
Every name and text box declares a plate: opaque or translucent (blurred paper).
Set mark, number/total, maker line and variant code present and inside the safe area.
Card id stable across variants; variants differ only in finish/frame.
Draw 280-380 ms, ease-out-back 4-8% overshoot, land squash.
Lift ~10% card height, scale 1.10-1.15, tilt <= 12 deg spring, moving specular.
Rarity glow before flip, hold per tier, flip 380-480 ms.
Card becomes its 3D model on the tile in <= 600 ms total with the world's settle animation.
Every motion has a sound; reveal sting for Sun tier.
prefers-reduced-motion path: crossfades, no tilt or shake.
60 fps with 10 cards in hand on an iPhone 12-class device.
Share of pixels out of the coated CMYK gamut <= 2% after soft-proof.
Max total ink <= 300%.
Text under 12 pt is 100% K or a solid spot colour.
Every finish has a matching mask layer at canvas size.
Pairwise judge: closer to Abbie's World references (Ranch tiles, concept board) than to any single source game's cards.

juice_timings_source.method: prior knowledge of public footage; measure on capture before treating as fact

checks: every text box on a plate (opaque or translucent)
quiet zones under plates: art-layer edge density <= 0.6x window average
subject crosses the window edge (art.window_bbox when the art covers the face) by 5-15% of trim height, on any side
crossing part is the focal part
subject bbox does not intersect cost or stat tokens
inner shadow at the window edge
horizon y and light direction identical across seams (horizon within 0.5% of height)
each card has its own focal subject
plain or gently graded backdrop (edge density < 0.02)
same key light across the set
motion limited to background or a small part of the subject
still frame passes every other check

manifest_fields.art.mode: one or more mode ids, e.g. ['overlay','popout','living']
manifest_fields.art.layers: list of layer files: bg, mid, subject, fg, shadow, depth
manifest_fields.art.window_bbox: [x,y,w,h] canvas px of the framed window; required for popout when art.bbox covers the face

art_direction.check: OKLab L difference between the focal area and its surround >= 0.3; focal area has the highest local contrast.
Posterised to 3 tones, a VLM still names the subject.
Subject nameable from a black silhouette at 64 px.
Key light upper-left about 45 deg, warm key, cool shadow, rim light; identical across the set (judge compares a set lineup).
Foreground, middle and background present; background contrast and saturation lower than the subject's.
Most saturated pixels cluster on the focal area; background mean chroma <= 0.7x subject's; colours within the set palette (deltaE <= 10 to a palette swatch for 90% of pixels).
Round for animals and food, square for buildings and tools; no sharp triangles except mild mischief.
No tangents: subject edges are not within 2% of the window edge without crossing it; headroom above the focal point.
Planned zones under name, plate and numbers are calm (see calm_text_zones).
3D renders: three-quarter view, 25-35 deg elevation for objects, 5-15 deg for heroic animals, 50-85 mm lens; same camera per card type across a set. Recorded in provenance.json.
A VLM shown only the art guesses the card's effect in a few words; judged against the rules text.
One medium per set (house: soft toy-diorama render with painterly light).
